text:
Ashlyn Ramos: Hi team! Ashlyn here — officially joining as PMM on Growth. Im mostly remote but plan to be in the SF office Tue/Thu. Im an enthusiastic amateur potter (and proud owner of a small, opinionated corgi named Mochi). Wondering where people stash ceramics tools/kilns and if theres any advice for hauling a starter to the office. :wave:
Mira Patel: Welcome Ashlyn!! Mochi pics please!! :heart_eyes:
Talia Bhat: Welcome!! Heads up: desk assignments & storage lockers are posted in #people-ops. Theres also a casual ceramics meetup on Tuesdays at lunch in the makerspace (zero experience required).
Noah Gameboy: hey hey  welcome! Theres a plant swap in the kitchen tomorrow at 11:30 and a welcome lunch at noon — perfect for meeting folks. Also, Mochi will definitely be famous. :tada: :dog:
Ashlyn Ramos: Ceramics meetup?? Count me in. Mochi is very dramatic about snacks. Sharing a terrible phone selfie here: https://imgur.com/example (placeholder)
Luca: Badge should be ready by ~10:30, swing by security. We have a small cart for moving heavy boxes/studio stuff  happy to lend. If you need a place to dry pieces, the makerspace has a drying shelf you can reserve.
welcome-bot: Reminder: complete HR onboarding checklist at https://redwood.example/onboard by end of day 3.
Talia Bhat: Quick poll: bringing a desk plant or nah? We tend to avoid gigantic cacti (they stage dramatic exits). :seedling:
Ashlyn Ramos: Bringing a spider plant named "Spin"  she enjoys indirect light and true crime podcasts.
Mira Patel: Also FYI theres a new-hire mingle Friday at 4pm in the lobby (snacks + dog treats). Mochi should bring a tiny sweater for the meet & greet. :balloon:
Noah Gameboy: Mochi welcome party confirmed. Dog-safe snacks appreciated. :cookie:
Ashlyn Ramos: Thanks for the warm welcome — excited to meet you all in person and join the ceramics lunch! :sparkles:
Luca: Ping me if you want help with desk setup or need a mic for demos. I can drop the dolly off at your desk.
